subject.title: fix(realtime-transcription): bound reconnects on a flapping-after-ready upstream (#102251)

question: Should this fix expose `reconnectStableResetMs` as a new optional `RealtimeTranscriptionWebSocketSessionOptions` field in the plugin SDK, or should the stable-reset window stay internal to the helper?
rationale: The reconnect bug fix itself is narrow, but the branch adds a new exported SDK option that plugin authors can see and depend on, which is a maintainer API-surface choice rather than a pure implementation detail.

options.title: Accept the additive SDK option
options.body: Keep `reconnectStableResetMs` as a narrow optional helper tuning knob, then fix the PR body closing reference and land after CI passes.

options.title: Keep the window internal
options.body: Ask for a revision that preserves the stable-ready behavior without adding a new public plugin SDK option.

options.title: Choose the sibling total-cap PR
options.body: Close this PR only if maintainers intentionally prefer the stricter total-lifetime reconnect cap approach in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102285.

recommendation.title: Accept the additive SDK option
recommendation.body: Keep `reconnectStableResetMs` as a narrow optional helper tuning knob, then fix the PR body closing reference and land after CI passes.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the prior realtime voice/transcription PR that established the helper and is the best available history-backed owner for the public SDK surface choice.
